note: Real partial mutation evidence. The conformance test at crates/tooling/chio-conformance/tests/threats/ssrf_via_http_substrate.rs calls the production chio_egress_contract::HttpEgressContract through the chio-http-core re-export. It admits an allowlisted public HTTPS authority, then rejects literal loopback, link-local metadata, and IPv6 ULA targets, an excessive redirect chain, and an oversized response. A targeted cargo-mutants run replaced HttpEgressContract::enforce_ip_address_class with Ok(()); the literal internal-address assertions caught the bypass. PARTIAL: pinned DNS rebinding resistance, complete outbound call-site adoption, deployment-specific hostname policy, and operator network restrictions remain deferred.
